scope: KUNTUR Competition Release v1.0 data engineering only

region.claim_policy: This rectangle is a pilot extraction area; it is not an administrative or watershed boundary and does not represent Coast, Andes, or Amazon masks.

merra2_monthly_slv.dependencies: Atmospheric reanalysis assimilating multiple observation sources; not a direct station observation.

gpm_imerg_monthly_final.native_temporal_statistic: monthly mean rate and monthly quality fields
gpm_imerg_monthly_final.dependencies: Final Run uses monthly gauge analysis; IMERG V07 algorithm also uses MERRA-2/GEOS fields in temporal interpolation. Not independent of MERRA-2.

gldas_noah025_monthly.native_temporal_statistic: monthly time means per source cell_methods metadata
gldas_noah025_monthly.dependencies: Land-surface model output; missing cells include source land-mask and other source missingness.

modis_mod13c2_monthly_ndvi.native_grid: global geographic Climate Modeling Grid, 0.05 degree
modis_mod13c2_monthly_ndvi.native_temporal_statistic: monthly vegetation-index composite; historical climatology-filled values may exist and are rejected by strict pixel reliability policy
modis_mod13c2_monthly_ndvi.dependencies: MODIS/Terra vegetation-index product; preserve source QA and native grid.

variables.name: 2 m air temperature (native units)
variables.screen_type: broad physical plausibility screen; not a NASA-declared range
variables.quality_policy: source fill/missing and source valid range if present; otherwise contract screen

variables.name: 2 m air temperature
variables.quality_policy: same validity mask as merra2_t2m_k; Celsius = Kelvin - 273.15

variables.name: 2 m specific humidity
variables.quality_policy: source fill/missing and source valid range if present; otherwise contract screen

variables.quality_policy: source fill/missing and source valid range if present; otherwise contract screen

variables.name: 2 m northward wind component
variables.quality_policy: source fill/missing and source valid range if present; otherwise contract screen

variables.name: surface pressure
variables.quality_policy: source fill/missing and source valid range if present; otherwise contract screen

variables.name: Final merged satellite-gauge monthly mean precipitation rate
variables.quality_policy: source fill/missing and source valid range if present; does not mask precipitation using quality index

variables.name: Precipitation accumulation derived from monthly mean rate
variables.quality_policy: monthly mean rate multiplied by exact proleptic Gregorian calendar hours; separate from NASA-provided rate

variables.name: IMERG random error estimate
variables.quality_policy: retain as source uncertainty context; not a confidence interval for the regional mean

variables.name: IMERG precipitation quality index
variables.screen_type: nonnegative sanity screen only; no quality threshold imposed
variables.quality_policy: reported as an index; never interpreted as a probability or used to mask precipitation

variables.quality_policy: verify source cell_methods includes time: mean; do not sum

variables.name: 10-40 cm soil moisture

variables.quality_policy: verify source cell_methods includes time: mean; do not sum

variables.name: 40-100 cm soil moisture
variables.screen_type: layer water-mass capacity screen, 600 kg m-2 maximum
variables.quality_policy: verify source cell_methods includes time: mean; do not sum

variables.name: 100-200 cm soil moisture

variables.quality_policy: verify source cell_methods includes time: mean; do not sum

variables.name: Evapotranspiration rate
variables.screen_type: source valid range only; no unsupported sign assumption
variables.quality_policy: verify source cell_methods includes time: mean; do not sum or multiply by month duration

variables.name: Storm surface runoff model field

variables.name: Baseflow-groundwater runoff model field
variables.quality_policy: source variable has acc suffix but monthly payload cell_methods must say time: mean; retain monthly mean and do not sum

variables.name: Snowmelt model field
variables.quality_policy: source variable has acc suffix but monthly payload cell_methods must say time: mean; retain monthly mean and do not sum

variables.name: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index
variables.quality_policy: raw range/fill; MODLAND good; usefulness 0 or 1; pixel reliability 0; land-only; no adjacent/mixed cloud; geospatial bits retained as context

variables.name: Enhanced Vegetation Index
variables.quality_policy: raw range/fill; MODLAND good; usefulness 0 or 1; pixel reliability 0; land-only; no adjacent/mixed cloud; geospatial bits retained as context

quality_policy.missing_values: Convert source _FillValue, missing_value, non-finite values, and values outside source valid_range to missing; never impute.
quality_policy.fallback_ranges: Apply only broad contract plausibility screens listed per variable when source-declared valid_range is absent; flag them as contract screens, not NASA declarations.

modis_c2.pixel_reliability: must equal 0 (good data); excludes fill, marginal, snow/ice, cloudy, and historical estimated rank 4
modis_c2.bits_14_15: retain as geospatial contribution quality context; do not treat as snow or shadow for MOD13C2 CMG
modis_c2.ndvi_evi_scale: raw int16 × 0.0001, per official MOD13C2.061 user guide; retain raw arrays and record a conflicting source scale attribute if present

quality_policy.spatial_aggregation: Compute regular-grid cell intersection areas on a sphere and clip each native grid cell to the pilot bbox. The reported coverage fraction denominator is the exact bbox area; the grid coverage fraction separately reveals area not represented by selected cell centers.
quality_policy.regional_quality: Report valid area divided by bbox area, valid fraction of represented native-grid area, fill/range rejection fractions, QA pass fraction, and cell counts. Keep null values and quality metrics when no valid cell remains.
quality_policy.imerg_quality_index: Do not use as a precipitation mask, probability, or confidence interval.
quality_policy.gldas_aggregation: Read and require source cell_methods containing 'time: mean' for all contracted monthly fields; preserve monthly means, including *_acc fields, without summing or duration scaling.

availability_assumptions.issue_time: 00:00 UTC on first day of forecast_origin_month
availability_assumptions.rationale: Conservative retrospective availability buffer; avoids assuming an incomplete prior month is released on the first day of the origin month. This is a frozen preprocessing assumption, not an audited NASA publication timestamp.
availability_assumptions.feature_selection: Only MERRA-2 monthly fields are used because their release-latency assumptions are explicitly frozen here.

forecast.partition_assignment: chronological by exact target month; no random split; all features precede issue time and target time
